verdict.rationale: Windmill documents a broad set of event triggers: webhooks, emails, HTTP routes, websockets, Kafka, Postgres, NATS, SQS, MQTT, GCP and Azure Event Grid. That covers email events, database new-record events via Postgres, and any app that can call a webhook. However, the evidence shows no native connected-app event triggers (e.g., new CRM record, new chat message, or form submission from a SaaS app), so ops users must wire up webhooks or infrastructure sources themselves. Missing for 10: app-level event connectors for SaaS sources, documented form-submission and message triggers, depth beyond a single overview line, independent hands-on corroboration.
